announcements.title: Keep your request reference after submission
announcements.body: Your request page contains the reference, target and private tracking code. Keep these details so you can return to the same record when following up.

announcements.title: Preparing documents for a permit application
announcements.body: Read the service requirements before applying. Use clear PDF, JPG or PNG files and make sure the documents relate to the premises, activity or event in your application.

announcements.title: Reply when a department requests more information
announcements.body: Open the request, read the officer's message and provide the requested clarification in the conversation. Your reply returns the record for further review.

announcements.title: Use the service directory to find the right department
announcements.body: Complaint and permit services are grouped by department. Review the description and requirements before starting a new request.

announcements.title: Protect your private tracking code
announcements.body: The public tracker requires your reference and private code. Do not post the code in a public message. Sign in to view documents and the complete conversation.

announcements.title: Review the outcome and provide feedback
announcements.body: Read the recorded decision and any follow-up instructions. After a complaint is resolved or a permit decision is recorded, you can leave a service rating from the request page.
